visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up on a fair-skinned hand wearing an ornate silver ring with a large pearl and multiple small diamonds. A manicured finger applies a dollop of translucent pink lip oil from a silver wand. The background is a blurred, neutral indoor setting with soft lighting. (2) A woman with striking dark hair and vibrant green highlights appears, wearing a pearl choker and multiple silver rings. She holds six YSL lip oil tubes in silver packaging, fanning them out in front of her face with a wide, excited smile. (3) Close-up shots show the woman applying various shades of lip oil to her lips. She uses the wand to carefully coat her upper and lower lips, showcasing the glossy finish. The lighting is bright and studio-focused, highlighting the product's texture and shine. (4) A brief scene transition shows the woman inside a bus, seated next to a man wearing a white shirt and glasses. She gestures expressively while talking, then the scene cuts back to the studio for more detailed lip swatches of different colors. (5) The woman applies a dark, brownish-red shade and makes a series of exaggerated, comedic facial expressions, including a wide-eyed look and a very large, open-mouthed laugh. The final shot is a close-up of her laughing hysterically with teeth visible.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A mid-tempo pop background music track begins with a steady electronic beat and bright synth melodies. There are subtle squelching and clicking sounds as a plastic applicator wand is pulled from a makeup tube and swiped against skin. (2) A female voice enters with extremely high arousal, shouting enthusiastically about the brand 'YSL' and 'lip oil.' The speech rate is very fast, and the tone is highly energetic and animated, matching the upbeat BGM. (3) The music maintains its steady tempo while the female narrator speaks in a professional yet friendly tone, describing specific makeup shades. The vocals are clearly enunciated with high pitch variability and frequent rising intonations. (4) A male voice with a calm conversational tone asks a short question. The female voice responds with a playful, high-pitched retort. Low-level ambient bus engine hum and muffled urban background noise are briefly audible. (5) The video concludes with the female voice emitting a long, loud, and rhythmic maniacal laugh. The laughter is high-volume and high-arousal, accompanied by the BGM which swells slightly before a hard cut to silence.
